expected_behavior: The total, the band and the completeness ratio come from score.mjs, so the same dimension scores always produce the same total.
No source is cited that was not actually fetched; a claim that could not be checked is said to be unchecked.
The critique is about the artifact, never about its author.
Accuracy, logic, clarity and completeness are always scored, never marked not applicable; another dimension may be marked n/a only with a stated reason.
The report names who reviewed it — the same agent or an independent one.
A quick roast keeps the quoted claims, the scored rubric and the proposals and says it is quick; it is never compared with a full roast's number.
